title: Black Week - Schweinfurt (14 Oct 1943)
notes: 8 crews: 4 with 95th BG led by Lt Robert Hughes, 4 with 390th BG led by Lt Owen 'Cowboy' Roane; crew tables, Kelsey account ('flew Heaven Can Wait'), Flanigan/Royal Flush caption ('I believe'), DUC note.

title: 3rd Bomb Division interrogation summary, 14 Oct 1943 (pages incl. 100 Group section), Fold3 images on 100th mission page
organisation: 100th Bomb Group Foundation (courtesy of Fold3; original USAAF record)
notes: Images IMG_8331/8332/8338: '100 GROUP - Our A/C participating in today's mission were flying in two group formations': low group of the wing formation, and high group with 95th.

title: Mission - October 14, 1943 - Schweinfurt, Ball Bearings (100th BG mission #36)
notes: Bombing result EXCELLENT; aircraft lost 0; crew lost 0; claims 7; strike photos SAV-100.

title: 100th BG crew database pages (Hughes 2470, Keel 2720, Lauro 3010, Flanigan 1654, Roane 4394, Lohof 3164)
notes: Original crew rosters; Roane page photo caption 'Oct 14, 1943 Schweinfurt: upon return, the crew took this photo'; Hughes photo caption: Hughes and Roane led composite groups of the 100th to Schweinfurt on 14 Oct 1943.

title: Aircraft 42-3271 'Nine Little Yanks and a Jerk'
notes: 351st, EP-L; history: 'RFO - Ford also FTO - engine trouble 10 Oct 43'; 'RFO - Lt. Robert L. Hughes' 5 Nov 1943; salvaged 7 Mar 1944.

title: Aircraft 42-31306 'Nelson King'
notes: 418th; pilot listed Emil Siewert. Later B-17G airframe; not the 14 Oct aircraft.

title: Aircraft 42-6087 'Royal Flush'
notes: 418th, LD-Z; known mission list (Ray Bowden / USAAF Nose Art Research Project) has 9 and 10 Oct 1943 (Rosenthal) then 13 Nov 1943 (Flanigan) - no 14 Oct entry.

title: Owen D Roane
notes: 100th BG, 349th BS; 'led the mission to Schweinfurt on 14-Oct-43'.
